2. Daily Summary
On October 1, 2026, Young & Sons Drywall crews continued interior work at Conroe ISD New Junior High School, including finishing work, insulation installation, and work performed on stilts with knee pads. Workers wore their required PPE at all times, and the hard hats, safety glasses, and gloves inspected were in good condition. Job progress was documented throughout the work areas, and a scaffold was present on the stairway. Housekeeping was maintained on site: trash was collected in the YSD trash buggy and kept in one pile, out of anyone’s way, and a cart was used to move materials for the work.
